$comment: COLLECTIONS-PROTOCOL-AND-PRODUCT-001 Part B §16 — the non-secret configuration required to provision the LIVE substrate under governance. NO secret material appears here: every credential is a NAMED reference resolved from the LIVE secret store at provisioning time. This profile is the authoritative input to the owner provisioning ceremony (docs/runbooks/collections-live-provisioning-ceremony.md). Provisioning the real substrate is an owner/governance boundary and is NOT performed autonomously.

financial_live_gate.note: Independent of Collections. Provisioning Collections schema/routes to LIVE does NOT open real-money movement.

database.name: banzami
database.isolation: dedicated LIVE cluster in a separate infrastructure boundary; never shares a host, volume, network or secret with SANDBOX

roles.$comment: Least-privilege model, proven on the disposable substrate (LIVE_DATABASE_ROLE_MODEL). Passwords come from secret_refs, never here.

bl_schema_owner.note: NOLOGIN; assumed only by bl_migration via SET ROLE

bl_migration.attrs: NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS, CONNECTION LIMIT 2, VALID UNTIL (short-lived, per ceremony)

bl_core_runtime.authority: ONLY runtime identity with write on financial state (money)

runtime_authority.$comment: Per-service DB authority is generated from db/authority/runtime-authority.json (WALLET-NATIVE-001) and applied after migrate, identically for LIVE. Collections/collection_shares/payment_intents are classified not_financial_money_tables.

secret_refs.$comment: Names only; resolved from the LIVE secret manager. Never committed.

network_boundaries.database_ingress: Core/runtime services only, over the LIVE private network; no public ingress to Postgres
network_boundaries.migration_ingress: the controlled migration executor only, during a sanctioned window; bl_migration is dropped/short-lived otherwise
network_boundaries.operator_access: bl_control_plane read-only for verification; bl_app_runtime host-only tooling; no direct superuser use at runtime

backup_policy.attestation: LIVE_BACKUP_VERIFIED=1 may be set to the controller ONLY after a real verified restore drill
backup_policy.down_migrations: forbidden; rollback is application/config + additive-compatible schema (no DROP/DELETE of ledger/history)

collections_capability.migration_tooling: target-aware controller ready (LIVE path implemented + disposable-proven)
